initial_receipt.explanation: The two-job execution contains a provenance fault introduced upstream. The downstream job received exact hash handoffs, so the bad evidence_sources artifact was passed through unchanged. In job_1, assemble_provenance emits evidence rows with record_id set to source_id instead of the original need record_id, producing records like record_id=s01 rather than n06-r01. Job_2 then cannot match evidence_sources to coverage records by record_id, so every priority row has upstream_rank 0, violating preservation of upstream provenance identities/order.
